//: The whole package — src, tests and the build scripts — for `pnpm -F server typecheck`. There is no separate emitting project any more: `backend.md` B1 replaced tsc's emit with an esbuild bundle (scripts/build.ts), because from B1 this server's program contains apps/app source — `lib/server/dict.ts` and `lib/dict/**`, whose relative imports are extensionless — which plain `node` cannot resolve and tsc does not rewrite. So this file is `noEmit` throughout and `moduleResolution` is `bundler`, which is what the bundle actually does. TWO CONSEQUENCES ARE B2's TO REVERSE. (1) `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is OFF. It was on while this package compiled nothing but its own src/; B1's temporary dictionary (backend.md B1: 'the dictionary comes with them, on purpose and temporarily') puts 40-odd apps/app modules and eleven packages/ai modules into the program, neither of which sets the flag — 71 errors, most in lib/dict/** and lib/types.ts, which this phase does not own. B2 deletes the server's dictionary; turn it back on in the same commit. (2) The `@/*` mapping points OUT of this package and into an app, which is backwards, and it is here for the same reason: B2's contract flip is what removes every `@/lib/**` import from apps/server/src/**. `apps/server/tests/workspace.test.ts` counts those imports so B2 has a number to drive to zero.
